learningObjectives: Identify correspondence recipients: a specific address, a field, a user reference, or participants
Compose email with the rich text editor and out-of-the-box correspondence templates that reuse Case data
Send email with a Send email automation, or via case-level notifications when an Assignment is routed to a worklist

elements.description: Three questions to answer when configuring automated email:
items: WITH WHOM — who receives the email (Recipient: a field value, user reference, or participant)
HOW — the message content (Correspondence template referencing Case data)
WHEN — when in the Case life cycle (Send Email automation Step placement)

elements.text: Email correspondence rules in Pega are like pre-written letter templates at a law firm: the partner (developer) writes the template once with [CLIENT_NAME] and [CASE_NUMBER] placeholders. When a case reaches the trigger point, Pega merges the template with real case data and sends the letter — 500 personalized letters without retyping each one.

elements.description: Send to a SPECIFIC email address (fragile if the address changes), or resolve at runtime from a FIELD value (e.g., Customer email field), a USER REFERENCE, or a PARTICIPANT. Runtime resolution is preferred.

A field pointing to one specific user, defined in the Case Type data model. CREATE OPERATOR and UPDATE OPERATOR are user-reference fields automatically defined for every data type associated with the Case Type.
Default Case participants (Pega resolves their email from participant info):
items: OWNER — the user who created the Case
CUSTOMER — the person the Case is for
INTERESTED — tracks progress only; not responsible for any action
bulletPoints: Choose the participant relationship that matches the intended stakeholder; do not confuse a participant category with automatic notification enablement.

elements.caption: Fixed addresses are supported but need maintenance. Create/Update Operator are references, not message templates.

elements.description: Pega provides a RICH TEXT EDITOR to create formatted email and REUSE Case data — e.g., greet the customer by referencing the first-name and last-name fields captured in the Case.
You can reuse out-of-the-box CORRESPONDENCE TEMPLATES that include Case processing data such as the Case ID (.pyID) and Case status (.pyStatusWork), instead of composing every email from scratch.

Add Send email at the workflow point where correspondence is required. Reaching this Step initiates sending to the configured recipient. A read receipt or reply dependency needs a separate design; this description does not guarantee successful delivery.
Enable Case-level email notifications for Assignment routing to a Worklist. The routed user is the recipient. Distinguish this event from arbitrary Case status changes and shared Work Queue routing.

elements.title: Correspondence Configuration Decisions

examPitfalls.title: Recipient maintenance
examPitfalls.trapDescription: Fixed email addresses are supported but changes require maintenance.
examPitfalls.bestPractice: Prefer a Field or user reference when identity varies.

examPitfalls.title: References versus templates
examPitfalls.trapDescription: Create Operator and Update Operator identify users for associated data types. They are not correspondence templates.

examPitfalls.title: Participant categories
examPitfalls.trapDescription: Owner, Customer and Interested describe stakeholder relationships. They do not mean every role is automatically emailed.

examPitfalls.title: Sending versus delivery
examPitfalls.trapDescription: Previewing or configuring content does not prove receipt, reading or a reply.
examPitfalls.bestPractice: Verify outbound delivery separately in the target environment.

examPitfalls.title: Trigger scope
examPitfalls.trapDescription: Workflow sending and Worklist routing notifications are two mechanisms covered here, not an exhaustive list of all platform email features.
examPitfalls.bestPractice: Choose the trigger for the actual requirement.

practiceQuiz.scenario: A confirmation email must be sent automatically when a Case reaches a certain point in the workflow, with no user action. What do you add?

options.text: A Send email automation Step — when the Case reaches it, the email is sent to the selected parties and the Case continues
A Collect information Step that asks a user to send the email
An Access Role that emails users on login
A Data Page that emails when refreshed

practiceQuiz.hint: Automatic email at a workflow point = Send email automation.
practiceQuiz.rationale: A Send email Step places automated correspondence at the required workflow point. Collect information would introduce a human task that is not required.

optionExplanations.A: A Send email Step places automated correspondence at the required workflow point.
optionExplanations.B: Collect information would introduce a human task that is not required.
optionExplanations.C: An Access Role is not the configured correspondence trigger.
optionExplanations.D: Data refresh alone does not establish this email automation.

practiceQuiz.scenario: An SA wants the recipient of a confirmation email to always be whatever address the customer typed into the Customer email field. Which 'Send to' option fits?

options.text: Send to a Field — Pega uses the value in the Customer email field at run time
Send to a specific email address typed into the rule
Send to an Access Group
Send to the Ruleset owner

practiceQuiz.hint: Resolve the email recipient from a Case field value at runtime.
practiceQuiz.rationale: The Field option resolves the customer-specific address from the entered value. A fixed address does not adapt to different customers.

optionExplanations.A: The Field option resolves the customer-specific address from the entered value.
optionExplanations.B: A fixed address does not adapt to different customers.
optionExplanations.C: An Access Group is not the customer address field requested here.
optionExplanations.D: The rule owner is not the customer identified by this requirement.

practiceQuiz.scenario: An SA must email whoever CREATED a particular record. Which user-reference field is available without being manually defined?

options.text: Create Operator — automatically defined in the data model for each data type (alongside Update Operator)
You must build a custom 'Creator' field from scratch
pyStatusWork holds the creator's email
The Owner participant is the only way to reach a record's creator

practiceQuiz.hint: Two operator fields are auto-defined per data type.
practiceQuiz.rationale: Create Operator is an automatically defined user reference for the associated data type. The source describes a built-in reference rather than requiring a duplicate custom field.

optionExplanations.A: Create Operator is an automatically defined user reference for the associated data type.
optionExplanations.B: The source describes a built-in reference rather than requiring a duplicate custom field.
optionExplanations.C: pyStatusWork stores Case status, not the record creator’s email.
optionExplanations.D: Case Owner and a particular data record’s creator need not be the same person.

practiceQuiz.scenario: A BA is configuring email notifications for a Case and needs to know which participants are available as recipients by default. Which TWO are valid DEFAULT participants you can email in Pega?

options.text: Owner — the person who created the Case
Interested — a person who tracks the Case but does not process it
Approver — the next person in the approval chain
Ruleset — the versioned rule container

practiceQuiz.hint: Three default participant types: Owner, Customer, and Interested — recall them.
practiceQuiz.rationale: Owner is the documented participant relationship for the Case creator. Interested describes a stakeholder who follows progress without processing work.

optionExplanations.A: Owner is the documented participant relationship for the Case creator.
optionExplanations.B: Interested describes a stakeholder who follows progress without processing work.
optionExplanations.C: Approver is not one of the three default participant categories listed here.
optionExplanations.D: A Ruleset is a rule container, not a stakeholder participant.

practiceQuiz.scenario: To avoid composing identical emails repeatedly and to embed the Case ID and status, what should an SA reuse?

options.text: An out-of-the-box correspondence template that includes Case data such as .pyID and .pyStatusWork
A Decision Table that returns email text
A Data Transform that prints the email to the log
An Access Role with an email body field

practiceQuiz.hint: Reusable formatted email with Case data = correspondence template.
practiceQuiz.rationale: A reusable correspondence template can insert Case ID and status data. A Decision table is not the correspondence composition tool asked for here.

optionExplanations.A: A reusable correspondence template can insert Case ID and status data.
optionExplanations.B: A Decision table is not the correspondence composition tool asked for here.
optionExplanations.C: Logging a value does not compose and send this customer message.
optionExplanations.D: An Access Role is not a formatted message template.

practiceQuiz.scenario: A team wants users to be emailed automatically whenever an Assignment lands in their worklist. How is this configured?

options.text: On the Case Type Settings tab → Notifications, enable 'Email user when the assignment is routed to worklist'
Add a Send email Step before every Assignment
Configure it on each operator's record individually
It happens automatically and cannot be configured

practiceQuiz.hint: Find Case-level notification settings on the Case Type Settings tab.
practiceQuiz.rationale: Enable Case-level email notification for Worklist routing in the relevant settings. Duplicating a Step before every task does not directly represent the routing notification configuration.

optionExplanations.A: Enable Case-level email notification for Worklist routing in the relevant settings.
optionExplanations.B: Duplicating a Step before every task does not directly represent the routing notification configuration.
optionExplanations.C: This topic describes Case-level enablement, not per-operator manual setup.
optionExplanations.D: The option is configurable; routing does not establish unconditional email enablement.

practiceQuiz.scenario: An email must go to the IT Manager referenced by a field in the Case data model. Which recipient approach matches this?

options.text: Use the IT Manager user-reference field
Always use the original Case creator
Use Case status as the email address
Use a fixed unrelated customer address

practiceQuiz.hint: Identify the user represented by the field, not a status or creator assumption.
practiceQuiz.rationale: The user reference selects the IT Manager represented by the Case field. The creator may be a different person from the required IT Manager.

optionExplanations.A: The user reference selects the IT Manager represented by the Case field.
optionExplanations.B: The creator may be a different person from the required IT Manager.
optionExplanations.C: A status value is not the required recipient identity.
optionExplanations.D: An unrelated fixed address ignores the designated manager.

practiceQuiz.scenario: A confirmation email has been sent. No response-handling or Wait Step is configured. What does Send email alone establish?

options.text: Sending correspondence; it does not itself establish a wait for reading or a reply
A mandatory wait until the message is opened
A mandatory wait until a reply is received
Automatic Case resolution regardless of the remaining workflow

practiceQuiz.hint: Separate sending from a workflow that waits for a response.
practiceQuiz.rationale: Sending and waiting for a response are separate workflow requirements. Opening the message is not an inherent wait condition of this Step.

optionExplanations.A: Sending and waiting for a response are separate workflow requirements.
optionExplanations.B: Opening the message is not an inherent wait condition of this Step.
optionExplanations.C: A reply wait requires an additional response-handling design.
optionExplanations.D: Sending a message does not inherently finish all remaining Case work.

practiceQuiz.scenario: A stakeholder tracks a Case but does not process its work. Which default participant role describes this relationship?

options.text: Interested
Customer, meaning whoever last edited any record
Owner, meaning every future assignee
Ruleset

practiceQuiz.rationale: Interested is the category for someone who tracks progress without processing the Case. Customer means the person on whose behalf the Case is transacted, not any record editor.

optionExplanations.A: Interested is the category for someone who tracks progress without processing the Case.
optionExplanations.B: Customer means the person on whose behalf the Case is transacted, not any record editor.
optionExplanations.C: Owner denotes the creator here, not every later task recipient.
optionExplanations.D: A Ruleset is not a participant category.

practiceQuiz.scenario: A claim needs a personalized email when it reaches Under Review. Which design directly expresses the workflow point and message data?

options.text: Send email at the required point, with a template or composed message containing Case references
Use static claim and customer values copied from an example Case
Configure only a View label and expect email delivery
Assume an SLA goal without an email action sends the required message

practiceQuiz.hint: Configure the trigger and dynamic content separately.
practiceQuiz.rationale: The Step supplies the send point and Case references personalize the content. Example values would repeat the wrong customer or claim details.

optionExplanations.A: The Step supplies the send point and Case references personalize the content.
optionExplanations.B: Example values would repeat the wrong customer or claim details.
optionExplanations.C: A View label does not establish an outbound send event.
optionExplanations.D: An SLA interval alone does not configure the required email action.

practiceQuiz.scenario: Inspection shows that the recipient field CustomerEmail is empty when Send email is reached. What should be corrected first?

options.text: Capture or populate the required recipient before this Step
Replace all property references with a fixed address
Change Case status to the email address
Expect the server to invent a recipient automatically

practiceQuiz.hint: Use the observed missing data rather than an unsupported delivery diagnosis.
practiceQuiz.rationale: The observed empty address must be captured or populated before sending. A fixed address would remove customer-specific routing rather than fix the missing data.

optionExplanations.A: The observed empty address must be captured or populated before sending.
optionExplanations.B: A fixed address would remove customer-specific routing rather than fix the missing data.
optionExplanations.C: Case status should not be repurposed as the recipient’s address.
optionExplanations.D: A mail server cannot infer the missing business recipient from this configuration.

practiceQuiz.scenario: Customers should receive a message when a Case reaches confirmation; workers should receive a message when an Assignment is routed to their Worklist. Which distinction fits?

options.text: A workflow Send email Step for confirmation; enabled Case-level Worklist notifications for workers
Only a Case label for both messages
Only a user-reference field with no send configuration
A participant category automatically sends every possible message

practiceQuiz.hint: Recipient data does not itself define the send event.
practiceQuiz.rationale: The two configurations represent distinct send events: reaching a Step and routing to a Worklist. A display label alone does not send either message.

optionExplanations.A: The two configurations represent distinct send events: reaching a Step and routing to a Worklist.
optionExplanations.B: A display label alone does not send either message.
optionExplanations.C: A recipient reference supplies identity, not the event that sends the correspondence.
optionExplanations.D: A participant role does not automatically define every notification event.

practiceQuiz.scenario: A Pega developer is designing a Claims process that must notify stakeholders at key milestones. Which TWO are valid ways to trigger an email from a Pega Case?

options.text: A Send Email automation step configured in the Case workflow at the desired milestone
Case-level notifications that automatically send an email when an Assignment is routed to a Worklist
An overdue report filter by itself, with no email delivery configured
A Case field calculation by itself, with no email delivery configured

practiceQuiz.hint: The topic covers workflow sending and Worklist-routing email notifications; this is not a claim that no other email mechanisms exist.
practiceQuiz.rationale: A Send email Step can send at the chosen workflow milestone. Enabled Case-level email notifications can respond to Worklist routing.

optionExplanations.A: A Send email Step can send at the chosen workflow milestone.
optionExplanations.B: Enabled Case-level email notifications can respond to Worklist routing.
optionExplanations.C: Filtering report rows alone does not configure message delivery.
optionExplanations.D: Calculating a Case field alone does not configure message delivery.

practiceQuiz.scenario: A developer is building an email correspondence template in Pega. Which TWO features are available in the Pega correspondence editor for composing emails?

options.text: A rich text editor for formatting the email body with headings, bullet lists, and bold or italic text
Property references that insert live Case data values (such as the applicant's name) into the email body at runtime
A guarantee of external delivery solely from a successful editor preview
Automatic translation of all text solely because the editor uses rich text

practiceQuiz.hint: Composition supports formatting and Case data insertion; it does not itself prove delivery or translation.
practiceQuiz.rationale: The rich text editor provides formatted correspondence composition. Property references reuse Case data in the composed message.

optionExplanations.A: The rich text editor provides formatted correspondence composition.
optionExplanations.B: Property references reuse Case data in the composed message.
optionExplanations.C: A composition preview is not evidence of external delivery.
optionExplanations.D: Rich text formatting does not inherently translate the message.

quickRecap.value: Specific address (fragile) → prefer Field · User reference · Participant. Create/Update Operator auto-defined per data type.
Owner (creator) · Customer (the person the Case is for) · Interested (tracker) · or All. Managed on Settings tab.
Rich text editor reuses Case fields; OOTB correspondence templates embed .pyID and .pyStatusWork.
Send correspondence at a workflow point; response waiting and delivery verification are separate concerns.
Enabled Case-level email notification responds to Assignment routing to a Worklist and addresses that user.
